card.name: Inside names and acronyms after D
card.fires_on: Pieces partway through proper names, surnames and acronyms, often right after a capital D or similar start, such as D-VI in DVI, Adham-i, Cialdini and CDAI.

modes.label: Surname pieces

modes.description: A letter after an initial D or inside a disease index acronym.
